text: 国新办就所谓“产能过剩”问题中方立场有关情况举行新闻发布会。商务部对外贸易司负责人贺少军表示，中国从不刻意追求贸易顺差，我们将继续积极推动进出口平衡发展，持续向全世界开放市场，坚定不移扩大进口。今年上半年，中国货物贸易进口增速为22.1%，明显快于出口。中国稳居全球第二大进口市场，超大规模的市场需求为贸易伙伴提供了强劲发展动力。特别是去年以来，我们打造“出口中国”品牌，计划每年举办超过100场进口促进活动，致力于与全球共享中国发展新机遇。在多国举办的“出口中国”境外活动上，许多中国企业与当地企业签订意向采购合同，拓宽了进口采购来源，为各国企业进入中国市场
text_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on China's stance on the so-called 'overcapacity' issue, He Shaojun, an official of the Ministry of Commerce's Department of Foreign Trade, stated that China never deliberately pursues a trade surplus. It will continue to promote balanced development of imports and exports, open its market to the world, and steadfastly expand imports. In H1 2026, China's goods trade import growth was 22.1%, significantly faster than exports. China remains the world's second-largest import market, and its vast market demand provides strong momentum for trading partners. Since last year, it launched the 'Export to China' brand, planning to hold over 100 import promotion events annually, sharing new development opportunities with the world. At overseas 'Export to China' events in many countries, Chinese companies signed intention procurement contracts with local firms, broadening import sources and providing access to the Chinese market.
